query: CREATE TABLE user_api_token(token_id UUID NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, user_id UUID NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, token_nbf TIMESTAMPTZ, /* The token is not valid before this date */ token_exp TIMESTAMPTZ, /* The token is not valid after this date */ allowed_ips INET[], created TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, revoked TIMESTAMPTZ, login_type CREDENTIAL_TYPE NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('api_token') STORED);
